about.title: Hi, I'm Volkan
about.text: I make games, 3D scenes and odd little web toys. Everything on this page runs right in your browser, so go poke at it.

projects.title: BMW M3 GTR
projects.subtitle: 3D walkaround scene
projects.desc: A Godot-built 3D walkaround of the BMW M3 GTR, exported to run in the browser.

projects.title: Just Jump It
projects.subtitle: 3D platformer game
projects.desc: A Unity-built 3D jump platformer exported to WebGL and playable in the browser.

projects.title: Retro Image FX
projects.subtitle: Effects studio
projects.desc: Scanline, ASCII-art and pixel-art effects with live sliders and one-click download.

projects.title: PS Music Player
projects.subtitle: PlayStation-style player
projects.desc: A PlayStation-inspired music player with spinning disc art, a scrolling track list and lyrics.

projects.title: Windows 98
projects.subtitle: Desktop in a CRT
projects.desc: A working Windows 98 desktop: Paint, Minesweeper, MS-DOS, a media player, Internet Explorer and more.

projects.title: Parking Puzzle
projects.subtitle: Pixel-art puzzle game
projects.desc: Slide the cars and free the red one. 20 levels, par moves and stars to earn.
